design.checkerboard: four 200-update checkpoints x two existing dev batches (seed 1105, 1106; indices 160-239)

criteria.arm_effective: the paired CF1-B_EH delta on the shared batch has a bootstrap 95% CI that excludes 0, |delta| >= 0.02 for decision accuracy, and the sign agrees on both existing dev batches
criteria.arm_indistinguishable: the CI contains 0, or the two existing dev batches disagree in sign
criteria.batch_dominant: the cross-batch same-arm spread is materially larger than the same-batch arm gap; the ratio is reported and 'materially' means > 2.0x
criteria.metrics: decision accuracy is the pre-registered primary metric; template bits, content bits and full-byte accuracy are reported separately and do not override the primary verdict
criteria.frozen: criteria fixed before the first world is scored; the runner aborts if the pre-registration file differs from this block
